Learning terms

Clear expectations.
Better experiences.

Read these details before registering for a class.

This website is operated by ISEW LIMITED, a company registered in Nigeria with the Corporate Affairs Commission under registration number 9646509. The academy trades as ISew with Gracy.

Course information

Fees, dates, format and materials can change. Confirm the current details with Gracy before payment. The course descriptions describe the techniques offered and do not promise income, accreditation or employment.

Payment and cancellation

Payments are handled by Selar or directly through the academy’s confirmed instructions. Ask for the applicable cancellation, refund and rescheduling policy before enrolling. This website does not collect card details.

Learning materials

Use resources supplied for your class for your own learning. Ask the academy before redistributing its videos, pattern sheets or other original materials.

Reviews and messages

Submit honest, relevant feedback. Do not include private financial information, passwords or someone else’s personal details. Reviews are moderated before publication.

Questions

Contact the academy if you need clarification about any class or term before purchase.
